tasks.label: 增量编译主程序 (qt-debug)
args: $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; if (-not (Test-Path 'out/build/qt-debug/CMakeCache.txt')) { throw '现有 qt-debug 构建目录不存在，请先配置项目。' }; & 'D:/vs2022/Common7/Tools/Launch-VsDevShell.ps1' -Arch amd64 -HostArch amd64 -SkipAutomaticLocation -ErrorAction Stop; $env:PATH = 'D:/QT/6.7.3/msvc2022_64/bin;' + $env:PATH; if (-not (Select-String -Path 'out/build/qt-debug/CMakeCache.txt' -Pattern '^VCPKG_MANIFEST_INSTALL:BOOL=OFF$' -Quiet)) { & 'D:/cmake/bin/cmake.exe' -S . -B out/build/qt-debug -DVCPKG_MANIFEST_INSTALL:BOOL=OFF; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE } }; & 'D:/cmake/bin/cmake.exe' --build out/build/qt-debug --target i2r_rlc --parallel 4; exit $LASTEXITCODE
